summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for NurseryPOS MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed covering business setup, categories, products (CRUD + adjust-stock + history), customers, invoices (with stock decrement + rollback on insufficient stock), purchases (stock increase + new product creation), dashboard summary, upload/files (Emergent Object Storage), and Gemini 3 Flash AI endpoints (identify-plant + scan-invoice) with real photos. Frontend: setup screen -> home dashboard -> search -> add to cart -> billing -> collect payment -> Cash -> invoice screen with PAID banner all work end-to-end on mobile viewport. Verified stock decremented (Money Plant 14->13) and dashboard updated (sales ₹250, 1 bill, 1 item, ₹250 cash). No deprecated Expo packages detected. All react-native components render correctly, testIDs are present on all interactive elements, touch targets look ≥44px. Test data cleaned after run.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoice stock decrement is not atomic across items (no MongoDB transaction) but has a compensating rollback loop that is correctly tested and works. Acceptable for MVP but note this is best-effort under concurrent load.
server.py is 599 lines — approaching the 700 threshold; consider splitting into routers per resource (products, invoices, ai, etc.) as the app grows.
Business singleton is stored via update_one upsert with _id='singleton' but GET returns doc with _id stripped — correct. No issues.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing seeded products (18) and categories (12). All TEST_-prefixed test data + the one test invoice + Money Plant stock were reset back to seed values after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_nurserypos_api.py and can be re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. AI tests use real photos fetched from Pexels via https (a plant photo and a receipt-like photo). Emergent Object Storage init is done at backend startup — /api/upload + /api/files/{path} both work. For the frontend, camera capture cannot be exercised in web preview; use the /search screen add-to-cart path to test billing end-to-end. Frontend test flow that works: setup form -> home -> /search -> tap search-add-{id} -> /billing -> cart-collect-payment -> payment-method-cash -> /invoice/{id} shows invoice-paid-banner.
